description: Golden SHA-256 integrity hashes of the canonical-JSON serialization of each save fixture (computeSaveFileIntegrity in packages/core/src/save-envelope.ts). Cross-runtime parity vectors: the TS drift guard (save-integrity-crosscheck.test.ts) recomputes these from the TS implementation, and the Unreal host harness (tools/verify-unreal/test_save_system.cpp) recomputes them from the portable C++ implementation. Both MUST agree — proving the canonical-JSON + SHA-256 save contract is byte-identical across runtimes. Regenerate with the TS drift guard if a fixture changes.
